component.name: Beeper
component.summary: All your chats in one app

description.p: Beeper is a universal chat app that brings conversations from many messaging networks together into a single unified inbox, with one searchable list of chats across all of them.

This is an unofficial Flatpak packaging of the official Beeper desktop application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Beeper or Automattic. The application itself is proprietary and is downloaded directly from Beeper's servers when you install this package; it is not redistributed here.
